title: Cho–Choi–Park independent-domination conjecture, odd case
statement: If an isolate-free finite graph G on n vertices has odd maximum degree D, then (D+1)(D+3)i(G)≤(D²+3)n, where i(G) is its independent domination number.

counterexample.description: An isolate-free finite simple graph of odd maximum degree for which exact minimization of independent dominating sets violates the stated inequality.
